title: Filthsystem Optimised Eyecandy
description: Client-side mods recommended for better performance (and some optional eyecandy) from the filthsystem Minecraft server.
body:
Official recommended clientside modpack for the filthsystem Minecraft.

This is an optional download. Vanilla clients can still play on the server, though the modpack is recommended for the boosts in performance it can offer, as well as additional, optional visual improvements such as shaders.
